id: \rThis has always been quite the quiet place. If it wasn't for the Gym I doubt anyone would stop by.
en: \rThis has always been quite the quiet place. If it wasn't for the Gym I doubt anyone would stop by.
it: \rQuesto è sempre stato un posto piuttosto tranquillo. Se non fosse per la Palestra, dubito che qualcuno si fermerebbe qui.

id: \bIf you battle Cissy you will need this.
en: \bIf you battle Cissy you will need this.

id: \bTM25 contains Thunder. It should be helpful in your Gym battle.
en: \bTM25 contains Thunder. It should be helpful in your Gym battle.
it: \bLa MT25 contiene Tuono. Dovrebbe esserti utile nella lotta in Palestra.

id: \bI've fished here for years, but I still haven't found the perfect Seadra.
en: \bI've fished here for years, but I still haven't found the perfect Seadra.
it: \bPesco qui da anni, ma non ho ancora trovato il Seadra perfetto.
